module: Underwater caustics post-effect. Creates (if they do not exist) the state block PFX_CausticsStateBlock (additive blending), the shader PFX_CausticsShader (caustics.cs.hlsl) and the PostEffect "CausticsPFX", disabled by default, which reads the prepass, the depth and two textures caustics_1.png / caustics_2.png. It is enabled and disabled by the callbacks of UnderwaterFogPostFx (see fog.lua). No exported function.
